about: Measures that are tabled but not yet law. Keep them apart from the rules in force: never apply them as current rules, and label every mention as proposed with the date it was tabled. Re-check once the Finance Act or the agency's own page confirms a measure, then move it into the rule files.

measures.measure: MSME income tax 14% on the first RM150k of chargeable income and 16% on the next RM450k, from YA2027
measures.applies_to: Resident SME companies (the rates today are 15% and 17%). Sole proprietors and partners pay personal income tax instead, so this does not apply to them. VERIFY against the Finance Bill.

measures.measure: Minimum wage RM2,000 a month from June 2027; MSMEs with sales under RM50m exempt
measures.applies_to: Employers. The exemption scope (who counts as an MSME for this rule) is not published yet. VERIFY.
